concept: RDS Multi-AZ: automatic failover to a standby in another AZ
tests: Which RDS configuration provides automatic failover to a standby in another AZ with no manual action.
expected: RDS Multi-AZ — a synchronous standby in another AZ, automatic failover via a DNS endpoint switch. Triggers: "automatic failover", "standby in another AZ", "no manual intervention".
why_not: Single-AZ with manual snapshots — no auto-failover; cross-Region read replica — for reads/DR, promotion is manual; backups in S3 — not failover.
